sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机，试图掩盖她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她只被称为“无名氏”。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 直到后来，侦探们终于查明了她的名字：艾达。

sentences.en: But identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 但确认她的身份后，这起离奇的谋杀案反而变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.

sentences.en: Formerly launched in 1996, the site has expanded to over 70 countries and is considered the leading classified service in any medium,

sentences.en: with an estimated value of more than a billion dollars.
sentences.zh: 估值超过十亿美元。

sentences.en: Each month, 200 million postings are made to Craigslist, which draw over 20 billion page views, making it one of the most popular websites in the world.
sentences.zh: Craigslist每月发布2亿条信息，吸引超过200亿次页面浏览，是全球最受欢迎的网站之一。

sentences.en: More than 90% of its traffic comes from the United States, where individual states and cities are given their own dedicated portals

sentences.zh: 方便用户将互动范围缩小到特定区域。

sentences.en: Ian Diaz took his work as a United States Deputy Marshal seriously, often wearing his uniform even when he wasn't on duty.
sentences.zh: 伊恩·迪亚兹非常看重他作为美国法警副手的职责，即使在休班时也经常穿着制服。

sentences.en: His identity revolved around his job, with the majority of his friends also working in law enforcement.
sentences.zh: 他的身份认同围绕着工作展开，他的大部分朋友也都在执法部门工作。

sentences.en: But despite his dedication to his career, he was eager to find fulfilment outside of work as well.
sentences.zh: 尽管对事业尽职尽责，但他同样渴望在工作之外找到满足感。

sentences.en: When he found himself newly single at the age of 38, he did what so many singles do in the 21st century.
sentences.zh: 38岁那年，他恢复了单身，于是做了许多21世纪单身人士都会做的事。

sentences.en: He turned to the internet.
sentences.zh: 他转向了互联网。

sentences.en: While browsing an online dating site,
sentences.zh: 在浏览一家在线约会网站时，

sentences.en: Ian connected with a 30-year-old woman named Angela Connell.
sentences.zh: 伊恩结识了一位名叫安吉拉·康奈尔的30岁女性。

sentences.en: After chatting for a little bit, the pair decided to meet in person.
sentences.zh: 聊了一会儿后，两人决定线下见面。

sentences.en: They had their first date on Saturday, January 2, 2016.
sentences.zh: 2016年1月2日星期六，他们进行了第一次约会。

sentences.en: The beginning of a new year seemed like an auspicious time to embark on a new relationship.
sentences.zh: 新年的伊始似乎是开启一段新恋情的吉时。

sentences.en: Ian found Angela to be sweet, charming and caring.
sentences.zh: 伊恩觉得安吉拉甜美、迷人且体贴。

sentences.en: She had a wide smile, dark brown hair and chocolate brown eyes.
sentences.zh: 她有着灿烂的笑容、深棕色的头发和巧克力色的眼睛。

sentences.en: Ian's attraction to Angela was reciprocated and the pair began a whirlwind romance.
sentences.zh: 伊恩对安吉拉的爱慕得到了回应，两人迅速坠入爱河。

sentences.en: Within the same month of meeting, Ian proposed marriage on Friday, January 29, and Angela accepted.
sentences.zh: 相识不到一个月，伊恩就在1月29日星期五求婚，安吉拉答应了。

sentences.en: Two weeks after they became engaged, the couple travelled to Boise, Idaho to visit Angela's parents.
sentences.zh: 订婚两周后，两人前往爱达荷州博伊西拜访安吉拉的父母。

sentences.en: During the trip, Angela announced to her fiancé and her family that she was pregnant.
sentences.zh: 旅行期间，安吉拉向未婚夫和家人宣布她怀孕了。

sentences.en: With the couple now expecting a child together, they decided to fast-track their relationship even further.
sentences.zh: 既然两人即将迎来共同的孩子，他们决定进一步加快关系进展。

sentences.en: When they got back to California, Angela would move into Ian's condo.
sentences.zh: 回到加州后，安吉拉便搬进了伊恩的公寓。

sentences.en: On the afternoon of Friday, February 19,
sentences.zh: 2月19日星期五下午，

sentences.en: Ian returned home to discover that Angela had moved herself in while he was at work.
sentences.zh: 伊恩回到家，发现安吉拉趁他上班时已经搬了进来。

sentences.en: The pair chatted about the pregnancy and Angela's lack of health insurance, deciding they should marry as soon as possible so Angela could access Ian's government health benefits.
sentences.zh: 两人聊到了怀孕和安吉拉没有医疗保险的事，决定尽快结婚，这样安吉拉就能享受伊恩的政府医疗福利。

sentences.en: Three days later, they tied the knot in a quiet courthouse ceremony.
sentences.zh: 三天后，他们在法院举行了低调的婚礼。

sentences.en: Everything appeared to be on track for their new life together.
sentences.zh: 一切似乎都朝着他们共同的新生活顺利进行。

sentences.en: Weeks later in April, tragedy struck when Angela suffered a miscarriage.
sentences.zh: 几周后的四月，悲剧发生了，安吉拉流产了。

sentences.en: The couple decided to try for another baby straight away and by the following month, Angela was pregnant again, this time with twins.
sentences.zh: 两人决定立即尝试再次怀孕，次月安吉拉就再次怀孕了，这次怀的是双胞胎。

sentences.en: What should have been a happy and exciting time was disturbed in late May when the newly wedded Angela Diaz began receiving some troubling emails.
sentences.zh: 本应是幸福兴奋的时光，却在5月下旬被打破，新婚燕尔的安吉拉·迪亚兹开始收到一些令人不安的电子邮件。

sentences.en: The messages were sent from a number of different email addresses attributed to the name Lilith.
sentences.zh: 这些邮件来自多个不同的电子邮箱地址，署名均为“莉莉丝”。

sentences.en: A figure associated with the Jewish mythology,
sentences.zh: 作为犹太神话中的人物，

sentences.en: Lilith is considered to be a dangerous and immoral temptress who steals babies in the night.
sentences.zh: 莉莉丝被认为是危险且不道德的诱惑者，会在夜间偷走婴儿。

sentences.en: One of the emails to Angela read,
sentences.zh: 其中一封发给安吉拉的邮件写道：

sentences.en: There are legends that Adam had a wife before Eve who was named Lilith, but this is not found in the Bible.
sentences.zh: “传说亚当在夏娃之前有过一位妻子叫莉莉丝，但这在《圣经》中并无记载。”

sentences.en: The legends vary significantly, but they all essentially agree that Lilith left Adam because she did not want to submit to him.
sentences.zh: “传说各异，但基本都认为莉莉丝离开亚当是因为她不想屈服于他。”

sentences.en: According to the legends,
sentences.zh: “根据传说，

sentences.en: Lilith was an evil, wicked woman who committed adultery with Satan and produced a race of evil creatures.
sentences.zh: 莉莉丝是一个邪恶、歹毒的女人，她与撒旦通奸，繁衍出了一群邪恶的生物。”

sentences.en: I hope you are scared of death tomorrow.
sentences.zh: “我希望你明天死于恐惧。”

sentences.en: Be prepared.
sentences.zh: “做好准备。”

sentences.en: Don't sleep.
sentences.zh: “别睡觉。”

sentences.en: Be watchful of the daughters of God.
sentences.zh: “小心上帝的女儿们。”

sentences.en: We will steal your child and we will watch as it dies.
sentences.zh: “我们会偷走你的孩子，并看着它死去。”

sentences.zh: “他利用你做任何事。”

sentences.en: Don't you see this?
sentences.zh: “你还没看出来吗？”

sentences.en: He is obsessed with me.
sentences.zh: “他对我着迷。”

sentences.zh: “我是他的珍宝公主。”

sentences.en: You are nothing.
sentences.zh: “你什么都不是。”

sentences.en: Watch your back tomorrow.
sentences.zh: “明天小心背后。”

sentences.zh: 另一封来自Lilithistruth@Outlook.com的邮件写道：“你会失去你的孩子，这是上帝的旨意。”

sentences.en: God's vengeance will rise up.
sentences.zh: “上帝的复仇将会降临。”

sentences.zh: 安吉拉还通过LinkedIn个人资料收到了消息，这是一个用于职业社交的求职网站。

sentences.zh: “米歇尔是他唯一真诚且受人尊敬的初恋。”

sentences.zh: 当伊恩看到这些信息时，他立刻认出了其中的措辞，并知道所指的“米歇尔”是谁。

sentences.en: Ian hadn't told Angela this when they first met, but he was embroiled in an ongoing legal dispute with his ex-partner, a woman named Michelle Hadley.
sentences.zh: 伊恩在刚认识安吉拉时没告诉她，但他正与前伴侣米歇尔·哈德利陷入一场持续的法律纠纷中。

sentences.zh: 米歇尔开始用邮件轰炸伊恩，想知道公寓会怎样处理，并要求他偿还欠款。

sentences.en: Her messages weren't always hostile.

sentences.en: Sometimes her demands for resolution were interspersed with words of gratitude, such as when she thanked Ian for sorting out her car insurance.
sentences.zh: 有时她要求解决问题的言辞中会夹杂着感激之词，比如她感谢伊恩帮她处理了车险。

sentences.en: But soon, the emails took a turn.

sentences.zh: 懒惰、愤怒、嫉妒，以及最严重的，你的傲慢。”
